scope: Official v1.9.5 (commit d1be6fd, tagged 2026-10-06) CPU build in an isolated directory; its CLI reports 1.9.5-dev because the upstream CMake WHISPER_BUILD_IS_DEV default is ON. Offline PCM16 mono 16 kHz WAV, explicit SHA-256 pinned local ggml model, one native thread, closed segment JSON, deterministic text/SRT/WebVTT. Qualification proves structure and the named public fixtures with ggml-base.en only; recognition accuracy is not certified. Source receipt must be refreshed after shared generation. Optional captionReview strengthens the existing handoff with a separately published, strictly recomputed editorial duration/code-point-density report; three current-source native kit cases pass, including one report case. Fixed thresholds are not standards, accessibility/readability or recognition certification. Short/dense flags are host-tested only; the real sample triggers long-duration. Optional maxSegmentLength (16 to 200) maps to the official CLI -ml N -sow after reading v1.9.5 whisper_wrap_segment/utf8_len: a native target counted in Unicode code points per token including the leading space, splitting only before space-led tokens, so longer words and unspaced scripts can exceed it; cue timing comes from experimental token-level timestamps and is not certified. One native jfk/base.en case plus a caption-review case; no multilingual claim. Fresh integrated native development-kit cases were repeated against the current source; consult the registered receipt for exact cases and recorded runtimes. This refresh does not broaden the documented operation or runtime-support scope. Fresh native development-kit cases were repeated on the integrated source; the registered receipt records exact cases and runtimes. This refresh alone does not broaden operation scope.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_whispercpp.py with the latest stable whisper.cpp CLI, an explicit pinned model and the public sample; require every native, hostile-evidence, workflow and lifecycle check before absorbing a release.
